problem: Creators lose track of product feedback, feature requests, and repeated customer questions across scattered channels.
evidence: Hypothesis only; collect public examples and interview or survey evidence before claiming demand.
solution_hypothesis: A lightweight feedback inbox that groups repeated requests and exports a prioritized backlog.

problem: Small projects can become difficult to price when scope changes and assumptions are undocumented.
evidence: Hypothesis only; validate against public discussions and competing paid templates before building.
solution_hypothesis: A project scoping and change-request workbook with estimate assumptions and a sign-off checklist.

problem: Low-volume sellers may manage stock, reorder levels, fees, and margins in disconnected spreadsheets.
evidence: Hypothesis only; verify competitor offerings, customer complaints, and willingness to pay.
solution_hypothesis: An inventory and reorder workbook with SKU-level margin calculations and low-stock alerts.

problem: Applicants can lose track of application stages, follow-ups, interview preparation, and role-specific notes.
evidence: Hypothesis only; validate through existing tools, public complaints, and interviews.
solution_hypothesis: A job search tracker with interview-preparation checklists and progress summaries.
